scene: A secret map drops from the parted laundry sheets.
picture: Rooftop tiles stretch across the bottom. On the far left, hanging white sheets flutter. To their right, a glowing parchment map drops through the air. Centre, the tall man in a red poncho and straw hat watches it. On the right sits a closed wooden crate. Up high, a utility cable slopes downward.
shown: a glowing parchment map fluttering downwards in the air on the left
an unopened wooden delivery crate sitting on the rooftop on the right
a taut metal utility cable stretching away from up high
